original_preserved: private local version-controlled intake; source not published

findings.finding: init is not __init__; constructors do not initialize the supplied classes.
Only minimum 52-byte length is checked; exact envelope size and payload length are not enforced. target_hmac is extracted but never authenticated.
Accepted epochs never advance a durable floor; replay protection is incomplete.
Peer identities, shard signatures, shard sizes and proposal binding are not checked; no validator allowlist or real consensus phases are implemented.
Signature shards from a prior pending proposal can remain when a new proposal replaces the context.
The peer shard is a hard-coded local hash, not an observed authenticated peer response.
Concatenated hashes are not the established 64-byte Ed25519 signature and cannot substitute for KEX geometry or contextual authority.
Validation failure clears VFS state and exits. Rejection must preserve canonical state and allow controlled recovery.
Dictionary writes have no durable storage, concurrency lock, atomic publication or verified readback.
The name does not provide an MCP SDK endpoint, protocol transport or principal authorization.
ASCII framing and evidence labels do not establish ISO accessibility or usability compliance.
A truncated hash over str(bytes) is not the canonical byte digest; presence of a dictionary key does not establish secure state.
No actual shared-memory substrate, UDS readiness, watchdog, Mining API gate, live worker observation or external publication verification is supplied.

reuse.admission: runtime/web4_admission.py retains authoritative 116-byte admission, literal-True verification, durable epoch comparison and receipt requirements. It fails closed while adapters are unbound.
reuse.substrate: runtime/serverspace_substrate.py remains isolated canary; no destructive VFS purge added.
reuse.mcp: existing official SDK and scoped backing handlers preserved
reuse.context: independent namespaces and parent contexts remain distinct; no scalar-unity merge performed
